commands: set -eu; temp_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/hammerdb-v6.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$temp_dir"' EXIT; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) archive=HammerDB-6.0-Prod-Lin-RHEL9.tar.gz; url=https://github.com/TPC-Council/HammerDB/releases/download/v6.0/HammerDB-6.0-Prod-Lin-RHEL9.tar.gz; sha256=b4e0b1c84f9ac74802c86628b3ebca527ef314404be68827fca30174147a92b6 ;; aarch64) archive=HammerDB-6.0-Prod-Lin-RHEL9-ARM64.tar.gz; url=https://github.com/TPC-Council/HammerDB/releases/download/v6.0/HammerDB-6.0-Prod-Lin-RHEL9-ARM64.tar.gz; sha256=6f6687ff3f9545dee2a1d2844a236a6df71a446621f750dad66dfd828ea5a4c9 ;; *) echo 'Unsupported HammerDB architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --output "$temp_dir/$archive" "$url"; printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha256" "$temp_dir/$archive" | sha256sum --check --status; mkdir -p /opt/crucible/software; tar -xzf "$temp_dir/$archive" -C /opt/crucible/software; test -x /opt/crucible/software/HammerDB-6.0/hammerdbcli; test -f /opt/crucible/software/HammerDB-6.0/LICENSE
